scope: Selected 36 × 14 mm key with R2 corners on each 36.2 × 14.2 R2.1 opening, 0.1 mm radial/lateral fit allowance. No support from component cases or friction. Checks use separate finite frame/sill mounting-stiffness scenarios at the prior governing strike, ordinary dock and single-wheel traction. The frame-side load path, local pressure peaks, actual slip, backing, vertical retention and the full simultaneous pose/hit set remain separate.
